title: Inbox One
description: Composer anchored to the bottom edge of the agent window (sticky, full-width backdrop with a fade so rows scroll under it; same 800px column as the session composer so it doesn't jump when opening a session). Inbox moved to the top of the window, with the "Good evening" greeting at the very top, left-aligned to the inbox's edge. The docked composer is the Agents window's new-session composer; inline replies and open sessions use the session composer with that session's harness, model and permissions. Every picker opens its real options. Visual sessions in Ready for you (tagged "Visual", from a fake "Fernwood" storefront repo) carry before/after screenshots of the shop's own UI: a phone product page, a cart drawer and a 1280px desktop homepage (wide shots open in swipe mode). The card sits 4px above the reply composer, with side by side / swipe icon toggles and an expand view. Request Changes is always on the card while you can reply; a PR adds Ready to Merge, and a question leads the card with its options as tabs on the After screenshot plus Choose, so no separate question card is shown.
